d: NCR Atleos, headquartered in Atlanta, is a leader in expanding financial access. Our dedicated 20,000 employees optimize the branch, improve operational efficiency and maximize self-service availability for financial institutions and retailers across the globe.
Location: Jeddah, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (KSA)

We are seeking an experienced Senior Project Manager to support the delivery of strategic enterprise initiatives within the Capital portfolio for a major financial institution in KSA. This role plays a critical part in driving high-impact projects, coordinating multiple stakeholders, and ensuring successful delivery in a complex financial services environment.

The Senior Project Manager is responsible for leading the planning, execution, and delivery of enterprise-wide projects through an outsourcing engagement. This role requires strong project leadership, stakeholder management, and the ability to coordinate across business, technology, and vendor teams.
The position involves managing project scope, timelines, budgets, risks, issues, dependencies, and governance requirements while ensuring alignment with business objectives and delivery standards.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field
Minimum of 10 years of project management experience
Strong background in banking or financial services
Experience delivering complex enterprise projects and managing multiple stakeholders
Excellent planning, organization, communication, and stakeholder management skills
Fluency in English and Arabic, both written and spoken
Previous exposure to capital markets, investment banking, asset management, or Capital-related initiatives
Professional certification such as PMP, PRINCE2, Agile, Scrum, or equivalent
Offers of employment are conditional upon passage of screening criteria applicable to the job.

d: You’ll lead the delivery of security services for clients in Kuwait, with a focus on SOC planning, design, and build-out. You’ll draw on Accenture’s global delivery network (methods, tooling, accelerators, talent) and tailor it to Kuwaiti clients, whether that’s a bank standing up a new SOC, an energy company monitoring critical infrastructure, or a government entity working toward national cyber security requirements. You’ll manage the delivery team day to day and make the calls that keep programs on track.
q: Strong, hands-on experience planning and building SOCs, including operating models, use case development, and onboarding of log sources
Solid working experience with Splunk SIEM operations
Good grasp of delivery governance, including reporting, risk management, and quality control
Experience leading and developing delivery teams
Ability to communicate clearly with technical teams and client stakeholders alike
Experience in the GCC market and familiarity with regional regulatory expectations
CISSP, CISM, or GCIH (at least one)
Splunk Core Certified Power User or Splunk Enterprise Security Certified Admin
PMP or equivalent project management certification
Nice to have: CISA, CRISC, or GIAC SOC-related certifications
